$comment: P69 (lane `cs`, D-C-A-NON-VOID-FUNCTION-WHOSE-END-IS-REACHABLE-IS-REFUSED): THE VALUE OF A LAYOUT CONSTANT IS THE TARGET'S, NOT THE HOST'S — the LLP64 half of a pair with `examples/c/constant_condition_reads_the_target_layout_lp64` (IDENTICAL main.c; the two manifests differ in their targets and in which function they expect to be reported). `sizeof(long)` is 4 on this target, so `when_long_is_not_eight` ends in an `if` that always returns — its closing brace is never reached and NOTHING may be said about it — while `when_long_is_eight` ends in an `if` that never fires: its end is reached on every call and it is reported once, at its brace (line 35). `expectWarnings` is exact over the code it declares, so the one entry asserts BOTH halves. This manifest is compiled on EVERY host by the in-process examples runner (and run where the target runs), which is what makes it the half that catches a fold done with the host's sizes: on a 64-bit Unix host such a fold would report line 40 here instead of line 35. See the LP64 manifest for the mechanism. The program exits 42.

THE LLP64 REFERENCES give this manifest its line: cl 19.51 (the action's report 20261010-184524-beb5e7c4) reports C4715 for exactly ONE function, `when_long_is_eight`, at line 35 — the `expectWarnings` entry below — and nothing for `when_long_is_not_eight`; mingw-w64 gcc 13.2.0 (20261010-184519-f98e4768) says nothing by default and reported that same one function under `-Wall` on these same bytes on 2026-10-08. THE LP64 REFERENCES give the twin its line: clang 18.1.3 on Linux x86_64 (20261010-184451-e6b04c9a, which also holds gcc's) and Apple clang 21.0.0 (20261010-184536-513767b0) report `when_long_is_not_eight`, line 40 column 1, and nothing for the other; gcc 13.3.0 says nothing by default and reported that same function under `-Wall` on 2026-10-08.
$commentRedOnDisable: WRITTEN, NOT READ — no mutation named here has been built and read, and this example is a corpus check, never a pin. The claims are unit TESTs: `Program_CompileFiles.BothTiersAgreeOnSizeofPerTarget` and its four neighbours in tests/program/test_compile_pipeline.cpp (the analyzer and the lowering give the TARGET's answer to each layout question, per shipped pair), and `NonVoidFunctionEndReached.ALayoutConstantIsTheAnalysisMachinesOwn` with `NoLayoutMeansALayoutQuestionIsNotAConstant` in tests/hir/test_non_void_function_end_reached.cpp. Each mutation is to be an arm of tests/mutations/arms.registry, and proves its claim when that arm reads `passed`. Until then this is a PREDICTION from the code, not a measurement: with the `sizeof` hook removed from the lowering's evaluator, or the model built without the layout parameters, `when_long_is_not_eight` would be reported too (a second warning of the declared code).
